invariant: Every physical experiment requires at least one explicit control/null geometry or density model.

models.name: No-void background
models.meaning: Set modeled cavity density contrast to zero while keeping observation geometry fixed.

models.name: Shafts only
models.meaning: Remove both 80 m terminal volumes from the conditional deep-claim model.

models.name: Terminals only
models.meaning: Remove all eight modeled shafts from the conditional deep-claim model.

models.name: Geometry perturbation family
models.meaning: Reserved for deterministic depth/size/location sweeps; never treated as observations.

models.name: Acoustic independent ±5% geometry family
models.meaning: Perturb component lengths/dimensions independently to test whether near-coincidences are geometry-specific.

models.name: Acoustic construction-relation preserving family
models.meaning: Perturb selected repeated passage relationships together so ordinary construction constraints are not destroyed by the null.

models.name: Simple analytical reference cavity/tube
models.meaning: Closed rectangular cavity and 1-D tube solutions used to validate the acoustic implementation.

models.name: Dry hydraulic null
models.meaning: Set connected water-column pressure to zero; prevents head calculations from implying observed flooding.

models.name: Rock-density sensitivity
models.meaning: Evaluate vertical overburden proxy at 2300, 2600 and 2800 kg/m³; not a posterior distribution.

models.name: Known lower-chamber depth reference
models.meaning: Compare deep conditional overburden scale with the known/derived lower-chamber depth under identical rho*g*h screening.
